name: discovery
description: Semantic roster lookup — reasons over the installed personas' descriptions and tool surfaces against a task intent and returns ranked candidates with a recommendation.

unmappedExclusions.*: home declares no excluded_tools — the deny list derives from home capabilities: no NetworkAccess (web_search, web_fetch), no AgentMessage (send_message), no lead role (interrupt_agent), no AgentSpawn (subagent, subagent_fork); write/edit stay granted (home WriteAccess self.* — per-path write scopes are not expressible on dsh, recorded fidelity loss)
